localRules.text: Lexington-Fayette has adopted Kentucky's Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act, so a landlord must give a written list of existing damage before taking a security deposit, and the tenant can check it before moving in.

tenantHelp.name: Kentucky Justice Online
tenantHelp.what: free legal information on deposits and evictions

climate: Test both heating and air conditioning, and check basements and crawl spaces for damp; Lexington has hot, humid summers and cold winters.
fact: Because Lexington adopted the state's landlord-tenant act, the move-in damage list is the main proof of condition if part of a deposit is withheld.
